light.aria:
- main:
  - link "Skip to planning map":
    - /url: "#planning-map"
  - group "Workspace":
    - strong: A.T.O.M
    - text: Telecom planning
    - button "Open project menu":
      - img
      - text: Ankara Plan
      - img
    - group: Working draft No Version Unsaved
  - group "RF context":
    - strong: Single · Cell 26380
    - text: · 5G mmWave · 28.0 GHz
    - group:
      - img
      - text: RF details
  - group "Status":
    - status: Run needed
  - group "Primary action":
    - button "Run Sector":
      - img
      - text: Run Sector
  - navigation "Workspace stages":
    - button "Plan workspace":
      - img
      - text: Plan
      - tooltip "Plan"
    - button "Simulate workspace":
      - img
      - text: Simulate
      - tooltip "Simulate"
    - button "Analyze workspace":
      - img
      - text: Analyze
      - tooltip "Analyze"
    - button "Review workspace":
      - img
      - text: Review
      - tooltip "Review"
  - region "Ankara propagation map":
    - group "Map controls":
      - group "Map interaction mode":
        - button "Inspect" [pressed]
        - button "Select cells"
      - button "Fit selected cells"
      - group "Result visualization":
        - button "Signal layer" [disabled]: Signal
        - button "Propagation rays layer" [disabled]: Rays
      - button "Map view options": View
      - button "Map layers":
        - text: Layers
        - img
    - button
    - button "Zoom in"
    - button "Zoom out"
    - link "Leaflet":
      - /url: https://leafletjs.com
    - text: ©
    - link "Stadia Maps":
      - /url: https://stadiamaps.com/attribution/
    - text: ©
    - link "OpenMapTiles":
      - /url: https://openmaptiles.org/
    - text: ©
    - link "OpenStreetMap":
      - /url: https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright
    - region "Map key":
      - button "Map key" [expanded]:
        - strong: Map key
        - img
      - region "Cell markers":
        - strong: Cells
        - text: Active cell Available cell Inspected cell Map Focus
  - dialog "Setup":
    - heading "Setup" [level=2]
    - paragraph: Mode, technology, power, and cell selection
    - button "Close tool drawer"
    - heading "Planning" [level=3]:
      - button "Planning" [expanded]
    - paragraph: Configure the current plan; run it from the command bar.
    - region "Plan setup controls":
      - text: Planning mode
      - button "Single sector mode" [pressed]: Single one sector
      - button "Network mode, 0 selected": Network 0 selected
      - text: Network technology
      - button "4G LTE, 2.6 GHz": 4G LTE 2.6 GHz
      - button "5G mmWave, 28 GHz" [pressed]: 5G mmWave 28 GHz
      - button "6G research profile (140 GHz), 140 GHz": 6G research 140 GHz
      - text: Propagation model
      - combobox "Propagation model":
        - option "Urban short-range (UMa)" [selected]
        - option "Legacy FSPL + walls"
        - option "Research sub-THz"
      - paragraph: Urban is the default at 2.6/28 GHz; 140 GHz is research-only.
      - img
      - text: Conducted TX power
      - spinbutton "Conducted TX power (dBm)": "30"
      - text: "dBm Valid range: 0–60 dBm"
    - heading "Advanced model details" [level=3]:
      - button "Advanced model details"
    - paragraph: Model applicability and link-budget assumptions for the selected profile.
